subject: ShellPkg/UefiShellLevel3: Extract MainCmdXXX() function
reasons: Large-scale refactoring that extracts a MainCmdXXX() function from each of 9 shell command files
Function extraction is not expressible in SmPL — Coccinelle cannot define new functions or partition existing function bodies into separate functions
Each extraction is unique to its command's logic and not a uniform structural pattern suitable for automated transformation
